scenario.topic: Decide on the benefits package for a small nonprofit office

options.name: Basic Health and PTO Plan
options.upside: Provides essential health coverage and PTO while fitting the budget.
options.concern: Limited PTO and modest retirement contributions may not fully meet employee expectations.

options.name: Enhanced PTO with Moderate Health Coverage
options.upside: Offers additional paid time off to support work-life balance.
options.concern: Health coverage is less comprehensive and retirement contributions are lower.

options.name: Comprehensive Health with Minimal PTO
options.upside: Includes broad health benefits and higher retirement contributions.
options.concern: Reduced paid time off may affect employee satisfaction.

options.name: Balanced Benefits Package
options.upside: Balances health coverage, PTO, and retirement within budget.
options.concern: Does not maximize any single benefit category.

shared_context: A small nonprofit office with 7 employees is selecting a benefits package. The package must include health insurance, paid time off, and retirement contributions within a limited annual budget of $50,000.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a benefits coordinator passionate about maximizing retirement contributions for long-term security.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the package offers strong retirement benefits even if PTO is limited.

A.reason_for: Provides essential health coverage and some PTO while fitting budget.
A.reason_against: PTO and retirement contributions are modest compared to other options.

B.reason_against: Lower retirement contributions and moderate health coverage are less appealing.

C.reason_for: Highest retirement contributions and comprehensive health coverage.

D.reason_for: Balanced benefits across categories within budget.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a pragmatic office manager who values balanced benefits that satisfy most employees.
personas.private_goal: Find a package that evenly supports health, PTO, and retirement without extremes.

B.reason_for: Extra PTO helps with work-life balance.
B.reason_against: Health coverage and retirement contributions are not as strong.

C.reason_against: Too little PTO, which may hurt morale.

D.reason_for: Balances all benefits fairly within budget.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a finance officer focused on maximizing PTO to improve employee satisfaction.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize paid time off even if retirement contributions are lower.

A.reason_for: Standard health and PTO, fits budget.
A.reason_against: PTO is limited compared to enhanced options.

B.reason_for: Offers the most PTO, supporting work-life balance.

C.reason_against: Minimal PTO is a major downside.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a senior staff member who prefers detailed discussions but tends to avoid direct confrontation.
personas.private_goal: Support a benefits package that improves PTO without sacrificing too much health coverage.

A.reason_for: Basic health and PTO meet minimum needs.
A.reason_against: PTO is limited, which affects morale.

B.reason_for: Enhanced PTO helps with work-life balance and moderate health coverage is acceptable.

D.reason_for: Balanced benefits with decent PTO and health coverage.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a junior employee who values essential health coverage and reliable PTO over retirement benefits.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the package provides solid health insurance and enough PTO for rest.

A.reason_for: Essential health coverage and PTO meet basic needs within budget.

B.reason_for: More PTO supports better work-life balance.
B.reason_against: Health coverage is moderate, retirement lower.

C.reason_for: Comprehensive health and higher retirement contributions.

D.reason_for: Balanced benefits but not maximizing health or PTO.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a practical operations assistant who prefers straightforward and balanced benefits.
personas.private_goal: Choose a package that fairly balances health, PTO, and retirement without extremes.

A.reason_against: PTO and retirement contributions are limited.

B.reason_against: Health coverage and retirement contributions are moderate to low.

D.reason_for: Balanced package that meets all core needs fairly.

personas.name: Tia
personas.background: Tia is an experienced nonprofit coordinator who values generous PTO to maintain staff well-being.
personas.private_goal: Advocate for more paid time off even if it means moderate health coverage.

A.reason_for: Basic health and PTO meet minimum expectations.
A.reason_against: PTO is limited compared to enhanced options.

B.reason_for: Offers the most PTO, supporting staff well-being.

C.reason_against: Minimal PTO is a significant downside.

D.reason_for: Balanced benefits with decent PTO and health coverage.
